nom: PEACH & LILY Lazy Day All-In-One Moisture Pads

avis.texte: I use these pads at night after a long day of work sometimes I dont want to do my whole skin care routine and these pads make my skin look flawless when I wake up in the mornings, as if i had done my entire skin care routine. I doubted this product but it does the job and feels absolutely amazing. I have combination skin but it works, and it minimizes my pores without clogging them. I also decided to use these for the days I had breakouts, to keep my routine minimal and it healed my skin very well. 10/10 product.

These pads are perfect for a morning routine when I have to be at work early and might not have time to wash my face. They are also great to use throughout the day after workouts or beach days. I love these so much.
Love this product! Definitely very useful and convenient on lazy days. My skin feels refreshed.
I'm often running late and these pads are great when I don't have time to do my usual morning skin care routine. A few swipes and then sunscreen and I'm good to go.
Really love the pads and serum. Makes your skin look much younger and less wrinkled.

avis.titre: This was out for months a
avis.texte: This was out for months and i have stocked up!! Must have priduct!!!

I use these pads more often than not! They are refreshing on my sensitive skin and don't cause flare-ups of my rosacea. It is so hard to find products for sensitive/rosacea prone skin so when I tried these I was skeptical, even though P&L are known for sensitive skin friendly products. I'm so glad I did, and that they FINALLY came back in stock. I'm planning on stocking up myself. 10/10 recommend
This is such a nice product, refreshes the skin while providing proper moisture. I love it so much it's ok auto ship.
These are awesome! So easy and convenient to use. Feels amazing in my skin. I will never be without them.
I always use this while traveling and find them very helpful! I have sensitive skin and it does not irritate my skin.

I love these for quick skincare in the morning before makeup! I do the full skincare routine before bed, but in the a.m. I just cleanse with water, a very mild exfoliation face pad(Thayers are amazing!), lazy day pad, eye cream, and moisturizing SPF(loving the new one from Innisfree). Let it all marinate and set, then do my makeup! Let me just say, my makeup lays like a dream following this method! No pilling, separating, flaking, or melting off! And my skin stays hydrated! I never want to run out of these facial pads!
Love the product, love how soft it makes my skin and love the price too!

These toner pads are the best! Easy to use, they tone and moisturize, great for travel. Gentle on my sensitive skin. They make my morning routine quick and refreshing. I have recommended them to so many people… Including staff at beauty supply stores that weren't familiar with them. I've been impatiently waiting for them to be back in stock in the jars rather than only the travel packets.
I love using these in the AM before my workout. A great way to not skip your skincare before a sweat session.

As a first-time mom, these toner-serum-moisturizer pads are literally lifesaving. Skincare is a huge part of my self-care, and to be able to engage with it even in a two-step kind of way (shout out Power Calm cleanser!) is very important to me. I do notice slight oiliness later on in the day if I forget to pat it in after swiping the pad, but that's something I'm totally willing to put up with because of the ease and simplicity they provide. It smells vaguely floral and nice! but not perfumed. It never feels sticky, just nourishing. I do think in the jar format over time the liquid settles to the bottom of the stack, but you can just take another cotton pad and press hard on the stack to resaturate the top ones. In the travel packs of six this is easily remedied by squishing it around while closed. PLEASE don't discontinue this product I love it so much!!!!

I have been using Peach & Lily for past 10 years. Truly a fan! And this product is a favorite in our house. These pads have been great especially on trips when you can't bring EVERY bottle of your skincare routine with you. Darn TSA limits! I wash my face with the gentle cleansing facewash. And then the pads in place of my other steps of my routine. These also work great when your face is all sweaty from gym, beach or humid icky day and you need a quick refresh! Doesn't dry you out, smells fresh and clean. Pads are texture but not rough. Truly a great one and done!! I never leave home without them! My son & daughter swear my them to keep face fresh especially on lazy days they dont want to go thru their whole routine!! The product name says it all!!!
These are genuinely lovely when you're feeling under the weather and I am begggggging y'all to restock the 60 ct jars

Words cannot describe how much I absolutely love these pads. I have purchased them a million times over the last few years and will continue to do so. I use them first thing in the morning to wake up my skin. They have never irritated my skin. My skin always feels refreshed in the morning after use. Please do not ever discontinue. I would cry!!!
Great for a day that I just want to apply one moisturizing product!
Packed with good ingredients, this moisture pad gives your skin exactly what it needs - fast. This is my third one already!
This moisture pad is full of skin-loving ingredients and gives your skin a quick boost of hydration.

I adore Peach & Lily and i own several of their products. I struggle with my mental health and many days i can barely wash my face, let alone do my full skincare routine. Thanks to these, i can take care of my skin without 5-6 steps. The only critique is that i typically have to moisturize after despite its claim to be a moisturizer as well. For reference, i have slightly dry, dehydrated skin.
Works well, especially when your pressed for time. It definitely stands up to it's name. It keeps my face soft and moisturized.

I love these pads! Very convenient to store at home or take on travel when you want to maintain your skincare and don't have the time for all the steps. Highly concentrated and I usually have a lot of excess essence I rub all over my arms, neck, and décolletage.
Super convenient and one of my favorite products for lazy days. There are several pads in the pack and I love how I can clean my face with one product in just a swipe.

avis.titre: For husbands who don't want to wash their face
avis.texte: My husband doesn't want to wash his face. I got these for him and he uses one in the morning and at night! It's easy and works so well for any skip type.

avis.titre: A staple in my skincare routine
avis.texte: These are my fave! Low effort and incredible results. I notice a difference when I use them vs. when I don't. They make my skin look and feel great. I even use them on my nails after & that helps keep my cuticles in check.
Really love these pads. Easy to pack a couple for short trips too.

I try to use these mainly for travel but they are so awesome when I'm feeling really lazy at night and just don't want to go through my routine. I wake up with a nice glow and don't feel guilty that I skipped out on my skin!

avis.titre: Lazy day all in one pass
avis.texte: Nice to have an easy routine for days I am in a hurry or for travel when you don't want to pack a lot of products. The container holds the moisture in the pads well and for a long time!feels great in my skin.
Bought it for hubby who is not into multiple steps of skincare. This works! Love how easy to apply daily!

I like to use these pads before I do gua sha. But I also use them on nights when I'm too tired to go through my usual routine. It's easy to get in the habit of using them on a regular basis until I remember how much I actually enjoy going through my usual routine. I always purchase more before I run out!

These little pads are a real treat when it's late or I am feeling lazy. Although they have everything in them (serum, moisturizer, etc. ), I still add Peach and Lily's Ultra Plush Cream on top because I have dry skin. I use both the jar of these pads and the travel packs for when I'm on the road. They are so moist that when I finish with my face, I rub the remaining on my arms and legs.

I do not have sensitive skin and I use both the gel water moisturizer and the glass refining serum from Peach and Lily so when I saw these I thought what a great idea for when I don't want to do a full skincare routine or for when I'm traveling to pack lighter. These broke me out so bad! I didn't know it was the pads at first as I only used it once and had a single pimple so I thought nothing of it. When I packed these for a trip instead of a full skincare routine that was a huge mistake. It started with just a few breakouts to which I thought was weird as I normally don't get them, but figured it must be stress related or something. On the third day in a row of using them my skin was red, irritated, and covered in zits. DO NOT USE THESE. Their other products are good. I love the gel moisturizer and glass serum, but these pads are evil
Makes my skin feel bouncy and clean! I love using these when I'm running late. . . . . or just plain lazy to do my skin care routine :blush:
It felt very hydrating. I use it for my lazy days or on the plane. I wouldn't use it for cleaning makeup off the skin though. High quality product that feels like my skin is getting nourished.
When I don't feel like doing my full routine, these pads are my go-to! Leaves my skin feeling fresh, clean, and moisturized.
Love this product. Works well with my skin. It doesn't dry my skin.

Love this product! Got it to wear those days I don't feel like doing much skin care. Just wipe one of these pads and you're good for the day! They do smell a little off, but when I apply it and it dries I don't notice the smell.

Too tired for a full skincare routine at the moment? Look no further than the Lazy Day All-in-One. It's fast, easy, cooling, and hydrating. Gets the job done quickly but doesn't sacrifice moisture. Love these for a quick routine.
These are fantastic and would work great for someone with less moisture needs. For me… i had to add a moisturizer on top each time. Not a deal break and honestly still great for travel.
I loved these! I used them on a road trip when I needed a pick-me-up and these delivered! They work so well at toning and hydrating. Please never stop making them!
These are a little harsh for super sensitive skin but they're very convenient

Keeps my skin hydrated all day and night and gives my skin a break from my skin care routine without drying it out or irritating it. I'll be getting these again when I run out, a life saver for last minute day trips or grocery runs.
Perfect for times when you are in a hurry or travelling. Apply after cleansing, and if going out and about, top off with an SPF moisturizer and go 🌞🌞🌞💆💆💆

avis.titre: Great for when you are in
avis.texte: Great for when you are in a hurry, travelling, or just feeling lazy haha! Very refreshing and gives mild exfoliation and when dry is ready for a layer of moisturizer or SPF.
These facial pads are exactly what it says! They are easy, and convenient to use day or night when you're feeling lazy! I love them, and plan to order more.
They are okay, but I feel like I need more hydration from them

avis.titre: I would definitely recommend this product
avis.texte: I like this product it does wonders for my skin it gave me immediate results
I can see how these would be amazing for travel or someone with not so dry skin. I am normal and they were not quite hydrating enough for me.
Super convenient but it would be even more convenient if they were in a more travel friendly container.
Sometimes you just don't feel like doing the full skincare routine. These pads are a lifesaver!
These are great! They don't irritate my sensitive skin, they're easy to use, and they're good for travel.

She's one of one; she's the only one; no other product offers as much as she does. You'll love her when you're lazy, love her when you're not; she is hydrating, refreshing, and will leave you with that supple look you crave. It's easy, peasy, lemon squeeze. Get her!

I recently traveled and purchased these instead of bring individual products. These pads worked perfectly to keep my skin in check and are perfect for traveling with only a backpack! I loved them so much, I may continue to use only these with the gel cleanser & face polish powder for my minimalist routine!!

avis.titre: The convenience is just the cherry on top
avis.texte: Love these pads and how they make my skin feel. They give my skins nice, refreshing boost after removing my makeup or after a long day.

I am not a morning person and these are a lifesaver. These effectively remove the leftovers of my night routine and moisturize and hydrate my skin. I love that it's only one step and my skin really loves them, too.
I use this in my morning routine. I rinse my gave with water, pat dry and then use this for a quick and all in one moisture pads. I love them and will definitely purchase again.
Favorite product to use on my bf after he passes out after a NIGHT OUT with the girls and the gays. He still wakes up soft and supple :)
Comes in handy when im having a busy morning or need a quick refresh when on the go. Also love thats its clean ingredients!
These are perfect for travel and for days when I don't feel like using multiple steps before bed

avis.titre: Feels like a spa visit in one second!
avis.texte: I love these lazy day pads! I am terrible about washing my face 2x a day, so these help me stay clean. The feel it leaves on your face is rather luxurious - like I just left the spa!
I use these when I'm in a hurry in the mornings. They are more moisturizing than I expected and great under makeup. About to take these on a trip too. Great product!

avis.titre: Lazy days are the best days
avis.texte: These pads are perfect for days when I'm short on time, not feeling well or just want a quick refresh! I'll be traveling across Asia in May and plan to take these with me to keep things simple. I've used so many of P&L products and they've been a game changer in my complexion, hydration and overall confidence.

Immesiatelt loved these. Noticed them gononnsale a few weeks later and bought two more to have on hand. They were like 50% off so I was scared rhey were discontinued. My onlt xomplaint is thar I wish they sold a travel size. I'd absolutely carry them in my bag to ise after workouts.
These are my favorite product discovery of all time. My favorite thing to use in the morning before taking care of my two kids. Cleanses, hydrates, it's wonderful

These have become a staple in my nightly and morning routine. I use these at night as an extra boost of hydration and goodness in my routine, and in the mornings as a nice simple basic cleanse. I also use them when I'm having migraine attacks as a super convenient and quick way to cleanse my face without having to do too much. Have repurchased more times than I can count and will continue to do so!
I've bought these twice. They're great to use after washing your face when you don't want to do a full routine with toner, essence, and serum.
I love this moisturizer pad—it gives instant glass skin that lasts all day. I'd happily replace my entire skincare routine with just this pad! However, it is a bit pricey. 😊
These are a great solution for when you don't need a full routine or are low on time or energy!

These pads are an instant pick me up when you do t have time for a full facial routine OR a great first step to your facial routine! They don't leave a sticky residue and my skin feels so nice after using these! Pair them with the Glass Skin serum and wow! I as on the fence about trying Peach and Lily but this product has won me over for them!
I really love how reliable and easy this product is it make my face feel so smooth and healthy

I love these pads. I bought them specifically for a trip I'm taking and did t want to clutter up my luggage with the full jar. The application is great they are so hydrating and prep you skin so well more more routine or a super quick way to not miss out on skin care routine during lazy spells
I'm honestly so impressed with this all in one product! It's definitely great to have on those in a hurry days!
Time efficient and definitely refreshing. These are my deployment go to! :) #militarygirly #peachandlily
Convenient to keep my skin looking healthy while camping or traveling. I'm a fan. I wish they made a travel size that was more lightweight.
I notice a huge difference on my skin when I don't use these every day. The hydrating pads are also really easy to travel with. They keep my face feeling silky and smooth.

I've been really happy with this product overall! These pads are perfect for when I'm to lazy/tired to wash my face after a long day. If I'm wearing makeup, I remove it with micellar water first, and then use these pads after. They moisturize my skin, don't feel too heavy, and smell great. The only thing I don't like about them is that they feel slightly sticky after drying. It doesn't bother me too much, but some people might not like the feel. Definitely recommend!

I continued to repurchase these all-in-one pads. I do not use them everyday, but rather for touchups between showers or for travel. They are so easy to use and have so much product saturated into each pad. I can use a single pad for my whole face and neck. As a bonus, after I wipe down my face I can spritz on some makeup remover to remove any mascara residue that is left behind on lazy days. These are so convenient and they last me quite a while as well. I purchased the travel pack of these as well to keep in my bag. It takes a few minutes for this to soak into my skin, but I do not mind. It leaves me feeling nourished and hydrated. I can add moisturizer on top during the winter to help quench my dry skin.
Love to use this when im on the move and cant get to a sink to deep cleanse my face. A little tacky after but it helps with not drying you out.

I've been looking for something like this for a long time. I love the price point for this. Others are more expensive. It's perfect to leave beside your bed for when you hop in the bed and you've forgotten to do your skincare and you don't want to get out of your cozy bed. This is definitely something that I'll be ordering in the future!!

I have loved these they are an absolute game changer! Before in lazy days when I didn't feel like doing the whole routine I would just skip it all together and my skin would suffer for it. Having so much of my routine packed into one easy pad has kept me way more consistent with my routine. They do leave your face feeling a little sticky after but I just dab a little of my moisturizer on and I'm good to go

I'm so glad I found these. I use them as an extra hydrating step in my normal skincare routine, or I use them when im feeling lazy and don't wanna wash my face! I love these so so much. I've repurchased at least 3 times now! And will repurchase more!

avis.titre: I LOOOVE these. I use the
avis.texte: I LOOOVE these. I use them on nights or mornings when I'm feeling lazy, when I need a refresh, and also as part of my regular skin care routine to add some extra moisture and glowiness! I cannot express how much I love these! Have repurchased 3+ times already and will continue to do so. :)

Bought for my son with combination skin. He has a routine for normal days, but on days he is running late or after the gym he can swipe these pads to keep skin clean and toned until bedtime. May need additional moisturizer on some days but overall helps keep skin fresh.

avis.titre: I have been using this fo
avis.texte: I have been using this for months! Best product I have ever used! Staple item in my routine now. I wish they had small sample size for traveling. I fly to Seoul year round and pick this up in the store also! This is how I get this in the states. Will not disappoint!

avis.titre: Great brand. The all in o
avis.texte: Great brand. The all in one makes serum plus toner plus everything else very simple. I do appreciate the laziness as the layer routine can be a bit much after a long day.
This is my second time purchasing this product and I still love it. It's convenient to use and easily absorbs into the skin.
This is perfect for lazy days. My skin soaks this up and feels so soft and clean after use. Love these!
Use these daily and I love them. They provide adequate moisture and a great addition to my regimen when I'm on the go and limited with time

avis.titre: Always a must repurchase for me
avis.texte: Great for quickly having something on the face before heading out.
I used these on an international trip to replace my normal skin care routine and they were great! My skin felt nourished and moisturized.
Bought these so I could travel a bit lighter and I think these will be a great backup plan. They still leave a little to be desired as they are not up to par with my regular P&L skin care routine.

These pads are good for those days that I'm too tired to go through my entire skin care routine. I still use my matcha moisturizer after because I feel like that pads don't leave my skin as soft as I would like, but still a great product.
